description: Deliver a reminder or follow-up without staying connected. Schedule one message and review its outcome. Start with in for a delay or at for a time; delivery uses this agent's identity and needs the destination's permission.
author: Serg Parf

in.help: Deliver one message after a delay. Delivery uses #at; the destination must allow #at.

args.name: in
args.help: 90s, 30m, 2h or 3d: one unit, at most 366 days

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows #at

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes

in.returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone

at.help: Deliver one message at a chosen time. Use HH:MM for its next occurrence in the configured time zone, or RFC 3339 with an offset.

args.name: at
args.help: HH:MM in Configuration tz (UTC unless the instance sets tz), next after this minute; or RFC 3339 with an offset

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows #at

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes

at.returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone

list.help: Review your pending messages and recent outcomes, with the configured time zone. The Owner and Maintainers also see other creators' entry IDs, targets and outcomes, without their message bodies.

cancel.help: Stop a pending message. Only its creator, the Owner or a Maintainer may cancel it.

help.help: Find available calls and their limits.

tz.help: IANA time zone for HH:MM times; must exist in the host's time zone data
